youtube_title: Headache By 4 Pm Daily? Check Your Water | Body Fix #25 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #25. Head heavy every day at 4 PM, and you reach for a painkiller?
B is right. Low WATER. Dehydration can cause headache and tiredness.
Check your pee: pale straw = good. DARK yellow = drink more.
Fix: Sip water all day, eat fruit, and chai doesn't replace water.
Red flags: Worst headache ever, fever + stiff neck, vision/speech changes? HOSPITAL now.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Dehydration
